summary.text: Heather Bagnall is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates for District 33C in Anne Arundel County, first elected in 2018 and a member since January 9, 2019. Her official page lists her as Chair of the Health Committee.

paragraphs.text: Bagnall's official page says she was born in Washington, D.C., graduated from Broadneck Senior High School in 1992 and earned a B.S. in theatre performance from Towson University in 1996.
It lists her as an arts educator and administrator since 1998, a playwright since 2009, and co-founding artistic director of Tasty Monster Productions since 2011.
The page lists her as a member of the House Rules and Executive Nominations Committee and the Legislative Policy Committee.

It says she served on the Health and Government Operations Committee from 2019 to 2025, chairing its Public Health and Minority Health Disparities Subcommittee from 2023 to 2025, and chaired the Anne Arundel County House Delegation in 2023 and 2024.
